headline: GreenDot to Acquire 50% Stake in French Packaging Recycler Léko
summary: Agilyx announced that its majority-owned unit GreenDot agreed to acquire a 50% stake in Valorie SAS, the company operating French packaging producer responsibility organization Léko.
why: Agilyx ASA is a plastic recycling technology company listed on Euronext Oslo.

impacts.name: Agilyx ASA
impacts.why: Agilyx's subsidiary GreenDot is acquiring a 50% stake in Léko operator Valorie SAS to expand its recycling platform.
